nodes.label: Hierarchical Auto-Merging Retrieval Strategy
nodes.rationale: Child nodes are stored as vectors in Qdrant for precise similarity search. When enough sibling children are retrieved (>=AUTOMERGE_THRESHOLD fraction), they are promoted to the parent node from docstore.json. This solves the 'needle in the haystack' problem: precise search via small chunks, richer context via larger parent nodes sent to the LLM.

nodes.label: Incremental Indexing via SHA-256 Manifest
nodes.rationale: Each document's SHA-256 hash is stored in index-manifest.json. On re-run, only new/changed documents are re-embedded; unchanged ones are skipped entirely. Deleted documents are cleaned from Qdrant and docstore. This avoids redundant embedding API calls on large corpora.

nodes.label: SSE Event Streaming Protocol
nodes.rationale: The /api/chat endpoint emits ordered SSE events: expansions, contexts, token (repeated), metrics, done, error. This allows the frontend to progressively display sources before the full response arrives, improving perceived latency.

nodes.label: Ollama Runs on Host (Not in Docker)
nodes.rationale: Ollama and the AI models run directly on the host machine, never in Docker containers. This ensures model data never leaves the local machine (GDPR/privacy), enables offline operation, and avoids Docker GPU passthrough complexity.
nodes.norm_label: ollama runs on host (not in docker)

nodes.label: Sequential Embed then LLM Model Loading
nodes.rationale: After retrieval, the embed model is unloaded from Ollama before the LLM loads. They run sequentially to fit in limited VRAM on a single GPU machine.
nodes.norm_label: sequential embed then llm model loading

nodes.label: Hallucination Prevention Strategy
nodes.rationale: Three layers: (1) empty-retrieval guard short-circuits before LLM if Qdrant returns zero results, (2) strict system prompt with 5 rules for source-only responses, (3) citation enforcement requiring [n] references for every claim.

nodes.label: Abbreviation Expansion via Dictionary Lookup
nodes.rationale: Abbreviations found during indexing are stored in abbreviations.json. At query time, a fast dict lookup expands them (e.g. 'VI' -> 'VI (Versleutelde Identiteit)') before embedding. No LLM call needed. User can toggle this per request via the frontend settings panel.

nodes.label: qwen3-embedding Model Selection Rationale
nodes.rationale: qwen3-embedding:latest chosen for: multilingual quality (strong on Dutch), 4096-dimensional vectors for expressive similarity distinctions, and top MTEB multilingual leaderboard performance.

nodes.label: flock-based reader/writer serialization
nodes.rationale: An flock on vector-db/.indexing.lock serializes writers (indexer, in-process or CLI) against readers (generating service re-reading docstore.json). The in-process threading.Lock in generating.indexing_runner stays separate: it gives concurrent HTTP triggers a fast 409, while the flock guards actual file access across any combination of processes, including the CLI path the threading.Lock cannot see.

nodes.label: AMX backend segfault workaround (Sapphire Rapids)
nodes.rationale: Sapphire Rapids Xeons trigger a segfault in Ollama's AMX-accelerated CPU backend during model warmup. Fix: rename libggml-cpu-sapphirerapids.so so Ollama falls back to AVX512 (cascadelake/skylakex). Must be re-applied after every Ollama update because updates re-extract the library and re-enable the crash.

nodes.label: RAG Retrieval Strategy (Hierarchical Auto-Merging)
nodes.rationale: Documents are chunked into parent nodes (PARENT_CHUNK_SIZE tokens) and child nodes (CHILD_CHUNK_SIZE = PARENT // 4); only child vectors are stored in Qdrant while parents live in docstore.json. Query time: embed → top-K child similarity search → AutoMergingRetriever promotes child groups to parent when >= AUTOMERGE_THRESHOLD fraction of siblings retrieved → SentenceTransformerRerank → top-N to LLM. Embed model is unloaded from Ollama before the LLM loads so both fit in limited VRAM by running sequentially.

nodes.label: Incremental Indexing (Qdrant as single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: On each run the indexer scrolls Qdrant once to read back each indexed file's file_path and content_hash payloads instead of maintaining a manifest file, so Qdrant itself is the single source of truth and cannot fall out of sync with a sidecar file. New/changed docs are re-embedded; deleted docs are cleaned up; unchanged docs are skipped entirely, avoiding needless embedding calls. Config drift (chunk sizes, embed model) is detected via the index_meta version stamp and triggers an automatic full rebuild.
nodes.norm_label: incremental indexing (qdrant as single source of truth)

nodes.label: Ophaalstrategie: Hiërarchisch Auto-Merging
nodes.rationale: Bij elke vraag: embedding → similarity search top-K child nodes → AutoMergingRetriever vervangt een groep child nodes door de parent node zodra de opgehaalde/child-ratio AUTOMERGE_THRESHOLD overschrijdt (meer context zonder zoekprecisie te verliezen) → reranking naar top RERANKER_TOP_N. CHILD_CHUNK_SIZE staat standaard op PARENT_CHUNK_SIZE // 4; afwijken geeft een waarschuwing bij het starten van de indexer.

nodes.label: Embeddingmodel keuze: qwen3-embedding
nodes.rationale: qwen3-embedding:latest gekozen vanwege meertalige kwaliteit (sterk op Nederlands), 4096-dimensionale vectoren voor expressievere similariteitsonderscheidingen, en consistent hoge MTEB-benchmarkresultaten (multilingual leaderboard).

nodes.label: Alle bronnen in één pass verwerken
nodes.rationale: Eerst worden alle documenten van alle wiki's en repositories opgehaald, daarna in één keer geëmbed en geüpsert — dit voorkomt dat het embeddingmodel meerdere keren geladen en ontladen moet worden.
